answer: An identity earns its seat through Licensed choir master appointment with choral society verification, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. Faking 504 identities means 504 fresh proofs and 47880 POA at risk, while the honest path risks nothing but a few minutes. One sparrow of signal, one timber of cost, one wharf of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
